items.title: Prime Bank holds financial literacy seminar for City University students
items.description: Prime Bank PLC, in collaboration with the Department of Business Administration of City University, organised a seminar, titled “Financial Inclusion: Engaging & Inspiring Youth in Banking”, under its flagship PrimeAcademia initiative.

items.title: Eastern Bank promotes Bangla QR across merchant network
items.description: Eastern Bank PLC (EBL) is promoting Bangla QR across its merchant network to make digital payments simpler, more convenient and secure as part of Bangladesh Bank’s “Cashless Bangladesh” initiative.

items.title: ShopUp, Oleyn host ‘All About AI’ with industry leaders
items.description: ShopUp, the largest B2B commerce platform in South Asia, hosted a panel discussion, titled “All About AI”, powered by Oleyn Limited, at the company’s headquarters in Tejgaon, Dhaka.

items.title: Asian carmakers besting US rivals at home
items.description: Major US automakers have watched their domestic market share shrink even more thanks to their Asian competitors -- a situation that may worsen if Chinese firms are able to enter the US market, an idea floated by President Donald Trump.
